note.wrong: All filled in, but it isn't right yet.

rules.title: How it works
rules.digits: Every row and every column holds each digit from 1 to {{k}} exactly once.
rules.blacks_one: Every row and every column has exactly one black cell.
rules.blacks_other: Every row and every column has exactly {{count}} black cells.
rules.sums: The numbers along the edge are the sums of the groups of digits that touch, in order. A black cell splits two groups.
rules.solved: Once everything is right, the puzzle is done by itself. Every step can be worked out, and you add up the sums yourself.
rules.score: Your score is the number of changes: every time you alter or clear a digit or a black cell. Zero is flawless.
rules.quick: Fill in faster: hold a cell, slide to a digit or black, and let go.

done.result: {{head}}. {{first}} cells in one go, {{later}} changed later.
